description:
A belief created at 0.80 and then talked down by six disconfirming records, ending below 0.45 with status still ACTIVE and still being composed.

The opposite sign of `tentative_suppression`, and a detector built for one sign misses the other. `_revise` does not write status (services.py:878), so ordinary disconfirming evidence moves the number and leaves the status where it was; `_stance_text` then renders 'Manyu sees this as true' with no reference to confidence (services.py:936). The public surface asserts as true what the store holds at near zero.

Experiment 5 section 5.1 recorded this as a limitation on its own reading. Here it is the channel.

expect.note: Structural properties, checkable by reading the file. No expected detector output appears anywhere in this fixture; requirements section 7. The confidence reached is not authored; the substrate decides where six records land it.
